reviewedBy: IPD automated evidence reconciliation under explicit owner-directed bounded calendar model, 2026-11-19 (not a claimed acceptance act)

qualification.segment: Cash equity exchange-wide regular/CAS/post-close session envelope; not per-security tradability or final-close publication assurance
qualification.outsideCoverage: UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE: only explicit rows qualify; no runtime weekday inference, elapsed-time or cross-venue fallback
qualification.intervalPolicy: Exchange-wide union of normal continuous and CAS matching hours, plus explicit post-close interval. Pre-open, block-deal-only, transition 15:35-15:50 and administrative/modification periods excluded. A live exchange interval does not imply every security is trading; retained LTP is not official close.

boundedModel.rule: Monday-Friday ordinary cash-equity sessions except published weekday holidays; Saturday/Sunday closed by default; explicitly announced live sessions override weekends. Materialized as explicit rows only within this bounded range.
boundedModel.basis: BSE 20251212-8 annual equity holiday/weekend separation plus 20260112-8 amendment; ordinary hours from owner-inspected 20250429-51; 20260801-1 amended hours; 20260803-35 and 20260825-29 pre-open amendments; independent 20261019-9 Sunday live session.
boundedModel.limitation: A proportionate bounded model assessed and applied under owner direction, not a claim that unread 20260430-18 explicitly states trading weekdays. No full-year normal-day or arbitrary-history qualification and no exhaustive circular-archive completeness claim. No security-specific tradability/finality guarantee.
boundedModel.amendmentApplicability: CAS hours effective 2026-08-03 and pre-open changes effective 2026-09-07 apply before coverage. Revised CAS effective 2026-12-07 is outside coverage and is not applied. Pre-open remains excluded from the existing exchange-wide interval policy.

sources.finding: Capital Market equity annual trading holidays; November 8 explicitly reserved for live Muhurat session.
2026 Equities trading table (not clearing table), ordinary weekday/weekend rule, regular and closing-session hours. Mutable page: publication date not stated; retrieved 2026-11-19, chunk 1.

Verified, but FUTURES & OPTIONS; NOT authority for cash-equity rows or their 15:30 normal close.
November 7 mock, no fund pay-in/pay-out; live re-login is not live trading.
November 14 mock, no financial obligations (Annexure 1); not a live exceptional day.

Bounded amendment review: November 7/14 mocks and future revised CAS notice; no additional live weekend session in this result. Retrieved 2026-11-19; index metadata, not contents of unread attachments.
Bounded review returned empty data. Retrieved 2026-11-19; not an all-history guarantee.
Equity and equity derivatives annual holidays. Only equity rows used; November 8 is an exception, NOT a closed holiday.
Independently confirms January 15 Equity Segment closure.
Current equity trading table agrees with annual list plus January 15. Publication date not stated; retrieved 2026-11-19. Does not establish a continuous normal-weekend calendar in this qualification.
Independent BSE Equity notice: Sunday November 8 continuous 14:20-15:30, CAS confirmation through 15:35, post-close 15:50-16:00.

Notice 20260801-1, directly retrieved previously: partially modifies 20260430-18 hours; T+1 09:15-15:30, T+0 09:15-13:30, CAS confirmation through 15:35 and post-close 15:50-16:00 effective 2026-08-03. Hours authority for bounded model; not explicit weekday-rule evidence.

Directly retrieved in prior continuation. Partially modifies Part II Chapter 1.1 of 20260430-18; revised pre-open effective 2026-09-07. No trading-weekday rule established.

Previously directly inspected. Revised CAS effective 2026-12-07: outside bounded November coverage, NOT applied to rows.
